title: The Cipher of Vienna
author: Sebastian Coldharbour
blurb: Freya Yarrow, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must burn the network that did the training before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
